payload.title: Crete Wedding Packages and What They Include
payload.excerpt: Two Crete wedding packages can carry the same name and share almost nothing on paper.
key_takeaways: A Crete venue package usually covers the ceremony set-up in a chosen space, sometimes with a coordinator, and everything else depends on the venue.
Guest rooms, minimum stays, the reception and outside suppliers are where Crete packages differ most, so ask about each one in writing.
A venue package, a venue fee and a planner each cover different ground, so check who is responsible for every part of the day.
Compare quotes on the same guest count, spaces, hours, nights and currency before you pay any deposit.

faq.q: Are Crete wedding packages all inclusive?
faq.a: Rarely. A package covers what its list names. Euphoria quotes its receptions, beverage packages and open bars separately, and Elounda SA lists reception food, drinks and entertainment outside its ceremony packages. Treat a package as the core of the day and ask for every extra in writing.

faq.q: What is included in a Crete wedding package?
faq.a: It depends on the venue. Abaton's The Basics covers the ceremony, coordination, photography, videography, bridal party flowers and a wedding arch, while Elounda SA's Lavish package includes a ceremony set-up, flowers and a menu tasting.

faq.q: Do Crete wedding packages include accommodation?
faq.a: Usually not, and some require it. Abaton's packages exclude accommodation and need a minimum room booking, and Elounda SA's packages need a stay of at least three nights. At Euphoria, a honeymoon package is included for couples who book a wedding package and stay at the hotel.

faq.q: Is there a Crete elopement package for just the two of us?
faq.a: Yes, at several resorts. Elounda SA's symbolic package is built for the couple, with witnesses if needed, sparkling wine, a single-tier cake and breakfast in bed the next day. Euphoria's Elxi option suits a couple with a handful of guests, up to 10.

faq.q: Does a venue package include the legal paperwork?
faq.a: Some include the official fees and some do not. At Elounda SA, the Municipal and Metropolis fees are charged on top of the package rate. Ask each venue what is covered and which fees sit outside its price.

faq.q: Is a symbolic ceremony in Crete legally recognised?
faq.a: No. Elounda SA's brochure is clear that a symbolic wedding or vow renewal is not a legal marriage in Greece. Couples who want a legal marriage can marry at home first and hold the symbolic ceremony in Crete.
